premises.text: Busy individuals need help managing household chores
premises.evidence_span: Dan needs help. Dan needs the butler you never had for the very first time, the luxury of personal service for the rest of us.

premises.text: Alfred provides a service that coordinates multiple on-demand services for users
premises.evidence_span: Alfred is actually a service lair. It sits on top of other on-demand and local services.

premises.text: Alfred assigns dedicated service providers to users based on availability
premises.evidence_span: we use a cluster and scheduling algorithm to assign him to an Alfred who has availability.

premises.text: Users can customize their service preferences for household chores
premises.evidence_span: you can set specific preferences. So, for example, in dry cleaning, Dan likes his clothes folded and maybe light starch.

premises.text: Alfred can manage multiple services in one app for seamless user experience
premises.evidence_span: he has in-app, seamless payment across all of his services, everything in one place.

premises.text: Alfred's model allows for economies of scale by grouping chores
premises.evidence_span: they group chores, which gives us economies of scale that we can pass along to you.

premises.text: Alfred can scale quickly by partnering with buildings to serve neighborhoods
premises.evidence_span: we partner with buildings, which allows us to turn on neighborhoods overnight, making us scalable.

premises.text: There is a large market for home services in urban areas
premises.evidence_span: there are over 200,000 households who are in our market, and we are quickly sanding them up.

value.text: Users gain time and convenience by automating household chores
value.evidence_span: Alfred brings together all the services you use seamlessly, going past the last mile to the last meter.

notes: Retention rate and market size are included as premises.
